result.summary: The page layout is largely coherent, but there is an inconsistent/low-contrast favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card, plus minor visual inconsistencies between restaurant card images and duplicate card styling.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) uses a dark, near-black circular background with a dark outlined heart, making the icon nearly invisible against its own background. The equivalent button on the ramen card above uses a white background with a dark heart, so the two controls are visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use the same white/translucent circular background and dark heart icon for all favorite buttons, or ensure the icon color contrasts sufficiently with the button background in every state.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a light gray image background while the neighboring cards have dark backgrounds, so the card looks unfinished or like a failed image load compared to its siblings.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (consistent background or overlay gradient) across carousel cards so all thumbnails read as intentional imagery.

issues.description: The duration badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') and delivery-fee pills overlap the card imagery with only a white pill behind them; on the light poké thumbnail the pill boundary is barely distinguishable, reducing legibility.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or border to badge pills and ensure a minimum contrast ratio against any underlying image.
